air.etymology: 源自拉丁语 aer 和希腊语 aēr,意为“空气、雾气”。

examples.en: A large amount of water was used.
What is the total amount?

amount.etymology: 源自古法语 amonter(上升、达到),由 a-(向)+ mont(山)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,常用于可计量之物

definitions.en: the feeling of being entertained or things that entertain

examples.en: The children played games for amusement.
She smiled with amusement.

amusement.etymology: 源自法语 amuser(使消遣),由 a-(向)+ muser(发呆、出神)构成。

examples.en: A dog is a friendly animal.
Wild animals live in the forest.
examples.cn: 野生动物生活在森林里。

animal.etymology: 源自拉丁语 animal(有生命之物),由 anima(气息、灵魂)派生。

synonyms.nuance: 偏书面,常指大型或凶猛动物

definitions.en: something you say or write when asked a question
the correct solution to a problem

examples.en: I do not know the answer to this question.
examples.cn: 我不知道这个问题的答案。

examples.en: Her answer made everyone laugh.

answer.etymology: 源自古英语 andswaru,意为“回应、誓言”。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,强调回应行为本身

definitions.en: a set of tools or equipment used for a purpose

examples.en: The lab has new apparatus for the test.
examples.cn: 实验室有用于测试的新器械。

examples.en: Climbing apparatus is in the playground.

apparatus.etymology: 源自拉丁语 apparatus(准备、装备),由 ad-(向)+ parare(准备)构成。

definitions.en: a good opinion of someone or something
official permission for something

examples.en: She looked at me with approval.
The plan needs the approval of the boss.
examples.cn: 这个计划需要老板的批准。

approval.etymology: 源自古法语 aprover(证明、认可),由 a-(向)+ prover(证明)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 侧重“准许去做”,不含赞许之意

definitions.en: an angry talk between people who do not agree
a reason given to support an idea

examples.en: They had an argument about money.
His argument was clear and strong.

argument.etymology: 源自拉丁语 argumentum(证据、论证),由 arguere(使清楚、证明)派生。

definitions.en: the making of beautiful things such as pictures or music

examples.en: She loves art and paints every day.
The museum is full of old art.
examples.cn: 博物馆里满是古老的艺术品。

art.etymology: 源自拉丁语 ars(技艺、技能)。

synonyms.nuance: 侧重需要手工技能的制作

definitions.en: an act of trying to hurt or beat someone

examples.en: The army made a quick attack.
examples.cn: 军队发动了一次快速进攻。

examples.en: The dog's attack frightened the boy.

attack.etymology: 源自意大利语 attaccare(连接、交战)。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式、更强烈,常用于暴力或法律语境

definitions.en: an act of trying to do something

examples.en: He made an attempt to climb the wall.
Her first attempt was not good.
examples.cn: 她的第一次尝试不太好。

attempt.etymology: 源自拉丁语 attemptare(试探),由 ad-(向)+ temptare(尝试)构成。

definitions.en: the act of watching, listening, or thinking carefully

examples.en: Please give me your attention.
The child wants more attention.
examples.cn: 这孩子想得到更多关注。

attention.etymology: 源自拉丁语 attendere(留心),由 ad-(向)+ tendere(伸展)构成。

definitions.en: the power of pulling something or someone toward you
something that people enjoy seeing or visiting

examples.en: There is a strong attraction between them.
examples.cn: 他们之间有强烈的吸引力。

examples.en: The park is a famous attraction.
examples.cn: 这座公园是著名的景点。

attraction.etymology: 源自拉丁语 attrahere(吸引),由 ad-(向)+ trahere(拉)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 侧重某物令人喜爱的特质

definitions.en: the power to give orders or make decisions
a person or group with official power

examples.en: The teacher has authority over the class.
The local authority built a new road.
examples.cn: 当地政府修了一条新路。

authority.etymology: 源自拉丁语 auctoritas(影响力、命令),由 auctor(创始者)派生。

synonyms.nuance: 更宽泛,不一定是合法或官方的

definitions.en: the rear part of the body from the neck to the legs
the part of something that is behind

examples.en: He carried the bag on his back.
Write your name on the back of the page.
examples.cn: 在纸的背面写上你的名字。

back.etymology: 源自古英语 bæc,意为“背、后部”。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,常用于车辆或建筑

definitions.en: a state where weight or force is evenly spread
the amount of money left in an account

examples.en: She kept her balance on the narrow bridge.
examples.cn: 她在窄桥上保持着平衡。

examples.en: Please check the balance in my account.
examples.cn: 请查一下我账户里的余额。

balance.etymology: 源自拉丁语 bilanx(有两个盘的天平),由 bi-(二)+ lanx(盘)构成。

definitions.en: the lowest part of something that it stands on
the main part from which something develops or operates

examples.en: The lamp has a heavy base.
examples.cn: 这盏灯有个沉重的底座。

examples.en: The soldiers returned to their base.

base.etymology: 源自希腊语 basis(踏步、基础),经拉丁语进入英语。

definitions.en: the way a person or animal acts

examples.en: His behavior at school was very good.
We study the behavior of birds.

behavior.etymology: 由 behave(举止)加名词后缀 -ior 构成,源自中古英语 behaven。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,常指道德或纪律层面的行为

definitions.en: a strong feeling that something is true or real

examples.en: She has a strong belief in herself.
examples.cn: 她对自己有坚定的信念。

examples.en: It is my belief that he is honest.

belief.etymology: 源自中古英语 bileve,由 be- + leve(相信)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 侧重无需证据的信任,常与宗教相关

definitions.en: the time when a baby comes out of its mother

examples.en: The birth of the baby made them happy.
examples.cn: 孩子的出生让他们很高兴。

examples.en: What is your date of birth?

birth.etymology: 源自古诺斯语 byrðr,与 bear(生育)同源。

definitions.en: a small amount or piece of something

examples.en: Give me a bit of bread, please.
I am a bit tired today.

bit.etymology: 源自古英语 bita,意为“一口、被咬下的一块”,与 bite 同源。

definitions.en: an act of cutting into something with the teeth

examples.en: He took a big bite of the apple.
examples.cn: 他大大地咬了一口苹果。

examples.en: The dog gave him a bite on the leg.

bite.etymology: 源自古英语 bitan,意为“用牙切入”。

definitions.en: the red liquid that flows through the body

examples.en: There was blood on his hand.
The heart pumps blood through the body.

blood.etymology: 源自古英语 blod,意为“血”。

definitions.en: a hard hit with the hand or a tool
a sudden event that causes trouble or sadness

examples.en: He gave the door a heavy blow.
The bad news was a great blow to her.
examples.cn: 这个坏消息对她是个沉重的打击。

blow.etymology: 名词义源自古英语 blawan(吹)及相关动词,引申为“击打”。

synonyms.nuance: 更口语,泛指碰撞或击中

definitions.en: the whole physical structure of a person or animal

examples.en: Exercise is good for your body.
examples.cn: 运动对你的身体有好处。

examples.en: The human body has many parts.

definitions.en: a yellow metal made from copper and zinc

examples.en: The door handle is made of brass.
Brass shines like gold when clean.
examples.cn: 黄铜擦干净后亮得像金子。

brass.etymology: 源自古英语 bræs,意为“黄铜”。

definitions.en: a food made from flour, water, and baked in an oven

examples.en: She had bread and butter for breakfast.
examples.cn: 她早餐吃了面包和黄油。

examples.en: Cut the bread into thin slices.

bread.etymology: 源自古英语 bread,意为“食物、面包”。

definitions.en: the air you take into and let out of your body

examples.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
He was out of breath after running.
examples.cn: 跑步后他上气不接下气。

breath.etymology: 源自古英语 bræð,意为“气味、气息、蒸汽”。

definitions.en: a boy or man who has the same parents as you

examples.en: My brother is two years older than me.
She has three brothers.

brother.etymology: 源自古英语 brothor,与拉丁语 frater 同源。

definitions.en: a structure with walls and a roof, such as a house

examples.en: That tall building is a hospital.
Many people work in this building.
examples.cn: 很多人在这栋楼里工作。

building.etymology: 由动词 build(建造)加后缀 -ing 构成,源自古英语 byldan。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,泛指任何搭建之物

definitions.en: an injury or mark caused by fire or heat

examples.en: She has a small burn on her hand.
The hot pan gave him a burn.

burn.etymology: 源自古英语 byrnan/bærnan,意为“燃烧”。

synonyms.nuance: 特指被热液或蒸汽烫伤

definitions.en: a sudden short period of an activity or feeling

examples.en: There was a burst of laughter in the room.
examples.cn: 房间里突然爆发出一阵笑声。

examples.en: A burst of wind blew the door open.
examples.cn: 一阵突来的风把门吹开了。

burst.etymology: 源自古英语 berstan,意为“突然破裂”。

definitions.en: the work of buying and selling goods or services
a matter that concerns a person

examples.en: He runs a small business in town.
examples.cn: 他在城里经营一家小店。

examples.en: That is not your business.

business.etymology: 由 busy(忙碌)加后缀 -ness 构成,本义为“忙碌的状态”。

definitions.en: a soft yellow food made from milk, used on bread

examples.en: Spread some butter on the bread.
This cake is made with butter.
examples.cn: 这个蛋糕是用黄油做的。

butter.etymology: 源自拉丁语 butyrum,再溯至希腊语 boutyron(牛酪)。

definitions.en: a strong heavy cloth used for tents, bags, and sails
a piece of such cloth used for painting on

examples.en: The tent is made of canvas.
The artist painted on a large canvas.
examples.cn: 画家在一块大画布上作画。

canvas.etymology: 源自拉丁语 cannabis(大麻),因帆布最初用大麻纤维织成。

definitions.en: the act of looking after someone or something
serious attention to avoid mistakes or harm

examples.en: The sick man needs a lot of care.
examples.cn: 这位病人需要悉心照料。

examples.en: Handle the glass with care.

care.etymology: 源自古英语 caru/cearu,意为“忧虑、悲伤”,后引申为“关心”。

definitions.en: the thing that makes something happen

examples.en: What was the cause of the fire?
examples.cn: 这场火灾的原因是什么?

examples.en: Bad food was the cause of his illness.
examples.cn: 变质的食物是他生病的原因。

cause.etymology: 源自拉丁语 causa,意为“原因、理由”。

synonyms.nuance: 侧重解释或说明,而非物理起因

definitions.en: a soft white stone used for writing on a board

examples.en: The teacher wrote on the board with chalk.
examples.cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。

examples.en: There is a piece of chalk on the desk.

chalk.etymology: 源自古英语 cealc,再溯至拉丁语 calx(石灰)。

definitions.en: a time when you can do something
the possibility that something will happen

examples.en: This is your last chance to win.
By chance, we met at the station.

chance.etymology: 源自古法语 cheance(落下、机遇),溯至拉丁语 cadere(落下)。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,强调有利的时机

definitions.en: the act of becoming different
the money returned when you pay too much

examples.en: There has been a big change in the weather.
examples.cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。

examples.en: Here is your change.

change.etymology: 源自古法语 changier,溯至拉丁语 cambiare(交换)。

definitions.en: material made by weaving cotton, wool, or other fibers

examples.en: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
Wipe the table with a wet cloth.

cloth.etymology: 源自古英语 clath,意为“布、衣物”。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,泛指各种纺织材料

definitions.en: a hard black material dug from the ground and burned for heat

examples.en: They burn coal to heat the house.
Coal comes from deep under the ground.

coal.etymology: 源自古英语 col,意为“煤、炭”。

definitions.en: the quality such as red, blue, or green that we see

examples.en: Red is my favorite color.
examples.cn: 红色是我最喜欢的颜色。

examples.en: What color is your car?

color.etymology: 源自拉丁语 color,意为“色彩、外观”。

synonyms.nuance: 指某种颜色的深浅变化

definitions.en: a state of being free from pain and feeling at ease
a feeling of being less sad when someone helps you

examples.en: The new chair gives great comfort.
Her words were a comfort to me.

comfort.etymology: 源自拉丁语 confortare(加强),由 com-(加强)+ fortis(强)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 侧重轻松无压力的状态

definitions.en: a group of people chosen to make decisions or do a task

examples.en: The committee will meet on Friday.
She is a member of the committee.

committee.etymology: 源自动词 commit(委托)加后缀 -ee,意为“受委托者组成的团体”。

synonyms.nuance: 常指管理决策的正式机构

definitions.en: a business organization that makes or sells things
the state of being with other people

examples.en: She works for a big software company.
examples.cn: 她在一家大型软件公司工作。

examples.en: I enjoy your company.

company.etymology: 源自古法语 compagnie，意为“同伴关系”，由拉丁语 com-(共同)+panis(面包)而来，本义“一起吃面包的人”。

synonyms.nuance: 多指较小的或专业服务类企业

definitions.en: the act of looking at how things are alike or different

examples.en: There is no comparison between the two cars.

comparison.etymology: 源自拉丁语 comparare(比较)，由 com-(共同)+par(相等)构成。

definitions.en: the act of trying to win or do better than others
an event where people compete to win

examples.en: There is strong competition for the job.
examples.cn: 这份工作的竞争很激烈。

examples.en: She won the singing competition.

competition.etymology: 源自晚期拉丁语 competitio，由 com-(共同)+petere(追求)构成，本义“共同追求”。

synonyms.nuance: 多指有规则的具体赛事
强调对手之间的对立关系

definitions.en: something that must happen before another thing can happen
the state that someone or something is in

examples.en: The house is in good condition.
I will help on one condition.

condition.etymology: 源自拉丁语 condicio(协议;条件)，由 con-(共同)+dicere(说)构成。

definitions.en: a link between two or more things
a relationship between people or ideas

examples.en: There is a clear connection between the two events.
examples.cn: 这两件事之间有明显的联系。

examples.en: My internet connection is slow.

connection.etymology: 源自拉丁语 connectere(连接)，由 con-(共同)+nectere(系;绑)构成。

definitions.en: the power to make something do what you want
to make something do what you want

examples.en: She has full control of the project.
examples.cn: 她完全掌控着这个项目。

examples.en: Try to control your anger.

control.etymology: 源自古法语 contreroller(核对账目)，由 contre-(对照)+rolle(名册)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 更偏向日常的处理与安排

definitions.en: a person who prepares and cooks food
to prepare food by heating it

examples.en: The cook made a delicious meal.
examples.cn: 厨师做了一顿美味的饭菜。

examples.en: I like to cook on weekends.

cook.etymology: 源自古英语 cōc，借自拉丁语 cocus/coquus(厨师)。

synonyms.nuance: 多指餐厅里受过专业训练的主厨

definitions.en: a soft red-brown metal used in wires and coins

examples.en: The wires are made of copper.

copper.etymology: 源自古英语 copor，源自拉丁语 cuprum，与塞浦路斯(Cyprus，古代产铜地)同源。

definitions.en: something made to look exactly like another thing
to make something the same as another thing

examples.en: Please make a copy of this page.
Don't copy your friend's answers.

copy.etymology: 源自古法语 copie，源自拉丁语 copia(丰富;数量)。

definitions.en: a light material from the bark of a tree
a stopper for a bottle made of this material

examples.en: She pulled the cork out of the bottle.
examples.cn: 她把瓶塞从瓶子里拔了出来。

cork.etymology: 源自西班牙语 alcorque，最终源自拉丁语 quercus(橡树)。

definitions.en: a soft white material from a plant, used to make cloth

examples.en: This shirt is made of cotton.

cotton.etymology: 源自古法语 coton，借自阿拉伯语 quṭn(棉)。

definitions.en: the act or sound of pushing air out of the throat with noise
to push air out of the throat with a sudden noise

examples.en: She has a bad cough.
He began to cough loudly.

cough.etymology: 源自中古英语 coughen，模拟咳嗽声音的拟声词。

definitions.en: an area of land with its own government and people
land away from towns and cities

examples.en: China is a large country.
examples.cn: 中国是一个幅员辽阔的国家。

examples.en: We spent the weekend in the country.
examples.cn: 我们在乡下度过了周末。

country.etymology: 源自古法语 contree，源自拉丁语 contrata(对面延展的土地)。

definitions.en: something put on top of another thing to protect it
to put something over another thing

examples.en: Put the cover back on the box.
Snow covers the ground.

cover.etymology: 源自古法语 covrir，源自拉丁语 cooperire，由 co-(完全)+operire(遮盖)构成。

definitions.en: a thin line on a surface where it is broken
to break so that lines appear, but not into pieces

examples.en: There is a crack in the wall.
The glass began to crack.

crack.etymology: 源自古英语 cracian(发出爆裂声)，为拟声词。

definitions.en: a way of buying things now and paying later
praise given to someone for something they did

examples.en: I bought the sofa on credit.
She got the credit for the idea.
examples.cn: 这个点子的功劳归了她。

credit.etymology: 源自拉丁语 creditum(借出之物)，来自 credere(相信)。

definitions.en: an act that is against the law

examples.en: Stealing is a crime.

crime.etymology: 源自拉丁语 crimen(指控;罪行)。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式，常用于法律语境

definitions.en: to press something hard so it breaks or loses shape
a large crowd of people pressed together

examples.en: Don't crush the flowers.
He crushed the can with his hand.

crush.etymology: 源自古法语 croissir(碾碎;发出碎裂声)。

definitions.en: to let tears fall from your eyes
to call out loudly

examples.en: The baby began to cry.
She gave a cry of joy.

cry.etymology: 源自古法语 crier，源自拉丁语 quiritare(高声呼喊)。

synonyms.nuance: 更书面，强调安静地流泪
只表示大声呼喊，不含流泪义

definitions.en: a flow of water, air, or electricity in one direction
happening or existing now

examples.en: The river has a strong current.
Be careful with the electric current.

current.etymology: 源自古法语 corant，源自拉丁语 currere(奔跑;流动)。

synonyms.nuance: 更泛指流动这一动作或过程

definitions.en: a line that bends smoothly without sharp angles
to bend in a smooth, rounded shape

examples.en: The road has a sharp curve.

definitions.cn: 使物体变暖的能量;高温
definitions.en: the quality of being hot; warmth

examples.en: The heat of the fire warmed us.
examples.cn: 火的热量使我们暖和起来。

examples.en: We could not bear the heat.

heat.etymology: 源自古英语 hætu,意为“热”。

definitions.cn: 为他人做事以使其更轻松
definitions.en: the act of making something easier for someone

examples.en: Thank you for your help.
She needs some help with the bags.

help.etymology: 源自古英语 helpan,意为“帮助”。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,常指物质或大规模支援

definitions.cn: 过去发生的事;研究过去的学科
definitions.en: events of the past; the study of the past

examples.en: We are reading the history of the town.
examples.cn: 我们在读这座城镇的历史。

examples.en: History is my best subject.

history.etymology: 源自希腊语 historia,意为“探究、记载”。

synonyms.nuance: 更宽泛,不特指学科或记载

definitions.cn: 在表面上的开口或空隙
definitions.en: an open space or gap in a surface

examples.en: There is a hole in my sock.
The mouse ran into a hole.

hole.etymology: 源自古英语 hol,意为“洞、空处”。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调两物之间的空当

definitions.en: the feeling that something good may happen

examples.en: There is still hope for them.
She kept her hope alive.

hope.etymology: 源自古英语 hopa,意为“希望”。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调想要某事,不一定相信会实现

definitions.en: a period of sixty minutes

examples.en: The trip takes one hour.
We waited for two hours.

hour.etymology: 源自希腊语 hora,意为“时间、季节”。

definitions.cn: 让人发笑或觉得有趣的特质
definitions.en: the quality of being funny or amusing

examples.en: He has a good sense of humor.
Her humor made us all laugh.
examples.cn: 她的幽默让我们都笑了。

humor.etymology: 源自拉丁语 humor,意为“体液”,古人认为体液决定性情。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调聪明而巧妙的言辞

definitions.en: water that has become hard from cold

examples.en: The ice on the lake is thick.
Put some ice in my drink.

ice.etymology: 源自古英语 is,意为“冰”。

definitions.cn: 脑中形成的想法或计划
definitions.en: a thought or plan formed in the mind

examples.en: I have a good idea for the party.
That is a clever idea.

idea.etymology: 源自希腊语 idéa,意为“形式、外观”。

definitions.cn: 突然产生去做某事的强烈愿望
definitions.en: a sudden strong wish to do something

examples.en: He bought it on an impulse.
She felt an impulse to laugh.

impulse.etymology: 源自拉丁语 impulsus,意为“推动”。

definitions.cn: 在数量、大小或程度上的增长
definitions.en: a rise in number, size, or degree
to make or become greater in amount

examples.en: There was a big increase in prices.
We need to increase our speed.

increase.etymology: 源自拉丁语 increscere,意为“生长”。

definitions.cn: 制造商品的生产活动或行业
definitions.en: the making of goods in factories; a type of business
hard and steady work

examples.en: The car industry is very large here.
examples.cn: 这里的汽车工业规模很大。

examples.en: Her industry helped her pass the test.
examples.cn: 她的勤奋帮助她通过了考试。

industry.etymology: 源自拉丁语 industria,意为“勤勉”。

definitions.cn: 用于书写或印刷的有色液体
definitions.en: a colored liquid used for writing or printing

examples.en: Write your name in black ink.
examples.cn: 用黑墨水写下你的名字。

examples.en: The ink is dry now.

ink.etymology: 源自古法语 enque,源自晚期拉丁语 encaustum。

definitions.cn: 有六条腿、身体分节的小型动物
definitions.en: a small animal with six legs and a body in parts

examples.en: An ant is a small insect.
Many insects can fly.

insect.etymology: 源自拉丁语 insectum,意为“被切分的(身体)”。

definitions.cn: 用于做特定工作的工具或器具
definitions.en: a tool used for a particular kind of work
an object used to make music

examples.en: The piano is my favorite instrument.
examples.cn: 钢琴是我最喜欢的乐器。

examples.en: The doctor used a fine instrument.
examples.cn: 医生使用了一件精密的仪器。

instrument.etymology: 源自拉丁语 instrumentum,意为“工具、设备”。

definitions.cn: 通过定期付费在出事时获得赔偿的安排
definitions.en: an agreement to get money if something bad happens, in return for regular payments

examples.en: We pay for car insurance every year.
examples.cn: 我们每年支付汽车保险费。

examples.en: Health insurance helps with doctor bills.
examples.cn: 医疗保险有助于支付看病费用。

insurance.etymology: 源自古法语 enseurance,意为“确保、担保”。

definitions.cn: 想了解或关注某事物的心情
definitions.en: the wish to know more about something

definitions.cn: 因借钱或存钱产生的额外款项
definitions.en: extra money paid for the use of money

examples.en: She has a great interest in music.
examples.cn: 她对音乐有浓厚的兴趣。

examples.en: The bank pays interest on your money.
examples.cn: 银行为你的存款付利息。

interest.etymology: 源自拉丁语 interest,意为“它有关系、重要”。

definitions.cn: 被创造出来的新事物或新装置
definitions.en: a new thing that someone has made for the first time

examples.en: The phone was a great invention.
examples.cn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。

examples.en: His new invention saves time.

invention.etymology: 源自拉丁语 inventio,意为“发现、想出”。

definitions.en: a hard gray metal
a tool used to make clothes smooth

examples.en: The gate is made of iron.
She used an iron on the shirt.

definitions.cn: 由果汁和糖制成的软而抖动的食物
definitions.en: a soft, shaking food made from fruit juice and sugar

examples.en: The children love red jelly.
examples.cn: 孩子们爱吃红色的果冻。

examples.en: This jelly tastes like apples.

jelly.etymology: 源自古法语 gelee,意为“凝结物”。

definitions.en: a place where two things are connected
to put together; to become a member

examples.en: You can see the join in the wood.
examples.cn: 你能看到木头上的接合处。

examples.en: Please join the two ends.

join.etymology: 源自拉丁语 jungere,意为“连接”。

definitions.cn: 从一地到另一地的行程
definitions.en: an act of traveling from one place to another

examples.en: The journey to the sea was long.
We had a safe journey home.

journey.etymology: 源自古法语 journee,意为“一天的行程”。

definitions.cn: 在法庭上作出裁决的人
definitions.en: a person who decides cases in a court of law
to form an opinion about something

examples.en: The judge listened to both sides.
examples.cn: 法官听取了双方的陈述。

examples.en: Do not judge a book by its cover.

judge.etymology: 源自拉丁语 judex,意为“裁判者”。

definitions.cn: 向上或越过的跳的动作
definitions.en: an act of moving up off the ground or over something
to push yourself up into the air

examples.en: He made a high jump.
The dog can jump over the wall.

jump.etymology: 可能为拟声词,16世纪进入英语。

definitions.en: an act of hitting something with the foot
to hit something with the foot

examples.en: He gave the ball a hard kick.
Do not kick the door.

kick.etymology: 中古英语 kiken,起源不确定。

definitions.cn: 用嘴唇触碰以表达爱意的动作
definitions.en: a touch with the lips to show love
to touch with the lips

examples.en: She gave the baby a kiss.
They kiss before saying goodbye.

definitions.cn: 通过学习或经验获得的信息和理解
definitions.en: what you know from learning or experience

examples.en: Books give us new knowledge.
examples.cn: 书籍给我们带来新知识。

examples.en: Her knowledge of plants is wide.
examples.cn: 她对植物的知识很渊博。

knowledge.etymology: 中古英语 knowleche,由 know(知道)加后缀构成。

definitions.cn: 地球上非水覆盖的部分;土地
definitions.en: the solid part of the earth's surface
to come down to the ground

examples.en: We saw land from the ship.
examples.cn: 我们从船上看到了陆地。

examples.en: The plane will land soon.

definitions.cn: 人们用来交流的词语系统
definitions.en: the system of words people use to talk and write

examples.en: English is a world language.
examples.cn: 英语是一门世界性语言。

examples.en: She speaks three languages.

language.etymology: 源自拉丁语 lingua,意为“舌头、语言”。

synonyms.nuance: 文学化,如 mother tongue 母语

definitions.cn: 表示开心而发出的笑声
definitions.en: the sound you make when you are happy or find something funny
to make sounds that show you are happy or amused

examples.en: She gave a happy laugh.
The joke made us laugh.
examples.cn: 那个笑话把我们逗笑了。

laugh.etymology: 源自古英语 hlæhhan,为拟声起源。

definitions.cn: 国家制定、人人必须遵守的规则
definitions.en: a rule made by a country that everyone must follow

examples.en: It is against the law to steal.
The new law starts next year.

law.etymology: 源自古英语 lagu,意为“规定之物”。

synonyms.nuance: 范围更广,不一定有法律效力

definitions.cn: 领先的位置或带头作用
definitions.en: a leading position in front of others
to go in front to guide others

examples.en: Our team is in the lead.
Please lead the way.

lead.etymology: 源自古英语 lædan(带领)与 lead(铅金属,古英语 lēad)同形。

definitions.cn: 获取知识或技能的过程;学问
definitions.en: the act of getting knowledge or skill; deep knowledge

examples.en: Reading is a kind of learning.
He is a man of great learning.

learning.etymology: 由动词 learn(学习)加 -ing 构成。

definitions.en: a material made from animal skin

examples.en: Her shoes are made of leather.
This leather bag is soft.

definitions.cn: 写给某人并寄出的书面信息
definitions.en: a written message you send to someone
a sign that stands for a sound in writing

examples.en: I got a letter from my friend.
examples.cn: 我收到了朋友的一封信。

examples.en: The word 'cat' has three letters.

letter.etymology: 源自拉丁语 littera,意为“字母”。

definitions.cn: 高度、数量或程度的位置
definitions.en: a position on a scale of amount, height, or degree
flat and even; at the same height

examples.en: The water level is rising.
Put the picture at eye level.

level.etymology: 源自古法语 livel,源自拉丁语 libella(小水平仪)。

definitions.cn: 搭乘别人车辆的便车;(英)电梯
definitions.en: a free ride in someone's car; a machine that takes people up and down
to move something to a higher place

examples.en: She gave me a lift to work.
Please lift the heavy box.

lift.etymology: 源自古诺斯语 lypta,意为“抬高”。

definitions.cn: 使我们能看见东西的能量
definitions.en: the energy that lets us see things
full of light; not heavy

examples.en: The sun gives us light.
Please turn on the light.

definitions.cn: 不可超过的最大数量或界线
definitions.en: the greatest amount or point that is allowed
to keep something within a fixed amount

examples.en: There is a speed limit on this road.
Please limit your words.

limit.etymology: 源自拉丁语 limes,意为“边界”。

synonyms.nuance: 更指地理或区域的边线

definitions.en: a kind of cloth made from the flax plant

examples.en: This shirt is made of linen.
examples.cn: 这件衬衫是亚麻布做的。

examples.en: Linen feels cool in summer.
examples.cn: 亚麻布在夏天摸起来凉爽。

linen.etymology: 源自拉丁语 linum,意为“亚麻”。

definitions.cn: 能流动、不是固体或气体的物质
definitions.en: a substance that flows, like water
in the form of a liquid

examples.en: Water is a clear liquid.
The ice turned into liquid.

liquid.etymology: 源自拉丁语 liquidus,意为“流动的”。

synonyms.nuance: 更科学化,含气体与液体

definitions.cn: 依次写下的一系列事项
definitions.en: a number of things written one below another
to write things in a list

examples.en: I made a list of things to buy.
examples.cn: 我列了一张要买东西的清单。

examples.en: Her name is on the list.

list.etymology: 源自古法语 liste,意为“边、条带”。

definitions.cn: 看一眼的动作;外表样子
definitions.en: an act of looking; the way someone or something appears
to turn your eyes toward something

examples.en: Take a look at this picture.
Please look at the board.

definitions.en: the fact of no longer having something

examples.en: The fire caused a great loss.
examples.cn: 那场火灾造成了巨大损失。

examples.en: Her loss made everyone sad.
examples.cn: 她的离去让大家很难过。

loss.etymology: 源自古英语 los,意为“毁灭、丧失”。

definitions.cn: 对人或物深切的喜爱之情
definitions.en: a deep feeling of liking and caring
to care for someone very much

examples.en: A mother's love is strong.
I love my family.

definitions.en: a device with moving parts that does work using power

examples.en: This machine makes paper.
The washing machine is broken.

machine.etymology: 源自拉丁语 machina,意为“装置、器械”。

definitions.en: an adult male person
human beings in general

examples.en: The man is reading a book.
That old man is my teacher.

definitions.cn: 负责管理一个团队或部门的人
definitions.en: a person who is in charge of a business or group

examples.en: The manager gave us new work.
examples.cn: 经理给我们安排了新工作。

examples.en: She is the shop manager.

definitions.en: a small spot or sign on a surface
to make a sign on something

examples.en: There is a dirty mark on the wall.
Mark the right answer.

mark.etymology: 源自古英语 mearc,意为“边界、记号”。

definitions.cn: 买卖商品的地方或活动
definitions.en: a place or event where people buy and sell things

examples.en: We buy fruit at the market.
The market is busy on Sunday.

market.etymology: 源自拉丁语 mercatus,意为“交易、集市”。

definitions.en: a large amount of matter with no fixed shape

definitions.cn: 物体所含物质的量(质量)
definitions.en: the amount of matter in an object

examples.en: A mass of dark clouds is coming.
The mass of the box is two kilos.
examples.cn: 这个箱子的质量是两公斤。

mass.etymology: 源自拉丁语 massa,意为“面团、团块”。

definitions.cn: 在固定时间吃的一顿饭
definitions.en: the food eaten at one time, such as breakfast or dinner

examples.en: We had a big meal at noon.
examples.cn: 我们中午吃了一顿大餐。

examples.en: Breakfast is my favorite meal.

meal.etymology: 源自古英语 mǣl,意为“固定时间、一餐”。

definitions.cn: 为达成目的而采取的行动
definitions.en: an action taken to reach a goal
to find the size or amount of something

examples.en: We took measures to stay safe.
examples.cn: 我们采取措施保证安全。

examples.en: Please measure the table.

measure.etymology: 源自拉丁语 mensura,意为“量度”。

definitions.en: the flesh of an animal used as food

examples.en: She does not eat meat.
This meat is very fresh.

meat.etymology: 源自古英语 mete,原意为“食物”。

definitions.cn: 人们聚在一起讨论事情的场合
definitions.en: an event where people come together to talk about something

examples.en: The meeting starts at nine.
We had a long meeting today.
examples.cn: 我们今天开了一个很长的会。

meeting.etymology: 由动词 meet(相遇)加 -ing 构成。

definitions.cn: 记住事物的能力;记住的内容
definitions.en: the power to remember; a thing you remember

examples.en: She has a good memory.
I have happy memories of school.
examples.cn: 我对学校有美好的记忆。

memory.etymology: 源自拉丁语 memoria,意为“记忆”。

definitions.cn: 坚硬、能导热导电的物质,如铁、金
definitions.en: a hard, shiny material like iron or gold

examples.en: Gold is a kind of metal.
The box is made of metal.

metal.etymology: 源自希腊语 métallon,意为“矿、金属”。

definitions.cn: 离两端距离相等的部分
definitions.en: the part that is the same distance from both ends
in a central position

examples.en: Stand in the middle of the room.
He sat in the middle seat.

definitions.en: the white liquid that cows and other animals give, used as food

examples.en: She drinks a glass of milk every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早晨喝一杯牛奶。

milk.etymology: 源自古英语 meolc，意为乳汁。

definitions.en: the part of a person that thinks, feels, and remembers
to feel bothered by something, or to take care about it

examples.en: A clear mind helps you make good choices.
examples.cn: 清醒的头脑能帮你做出好的选择。

mind.etymology: 源自古英语 gemynd，意为记忆、思想。

synonyms.nuance: 更指生理上的器官,而 mind 偏指思维活动

definitions.en: a deep hole or system of holes under the ground where coal, gold, etc. is taken out
a bomb hidden under the ground or in water

examples.en: The men work all day in the coal mine.
examples.cn: 工人们整天在煤矿里干活。

mine.etymology: 源自古法语 mine，意为矿脉。

definitions.en: a unit of time equal to 60 seconds; a very short time

examples.en: Wait a minute, I am almost ready.

minute.etymology: 源自拉丁语 minutus，意为微小的(指被分小的部分)。

definitions.en: a thin cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see far

examples.en: Early in the day the hills were covered with mist.

mist.etymology: 源自古英语 mist，意为雾、模糊。

synonyms.nuance: 比 mist 更浓更厚,能见度更低

definitions.en: coins or paper notes used to buy things

examples.en: He saved enough money to buy a house.

money.etymology: 源自拉丁语 moneta，意为铸币(亦为造币厂女神之名)。

synonyms.nuance: 特指纸币和硬币,不含银行存款

definitions.en: one of the twelve parts that a year is divided into

examples.en: We will go on holiday next month.

month.etymology: 源自古英语 monath，与 moon(月亮)同源。

definitions.en: the early part of the day, from when the sun comes up until noon

examples.en: I go for a run every morning.

morning.etymology: 源自中古英语 morwening，由 morn(清晨)派生。

definitions.en: a woman who has a child

examples.en: His mother cooks dinner for the family.
examples.cn: 他的母亲为全家做晚饭。

mother.etymology: 源自古英语 modor，印欧语系共有的亲属词。

definitions.en: the act of moving or the way something moves
a formal suggestion made at a meeting to be voted on

examples.en: The motion of the boat made her feel sick.
examples.cn: 船的晃动让她感到不舒服。

motion.etymology: 源自拉丁语 motio，由 movere(移动)派生。

definitions.en: a very high hill, often with rock at the top

examples.en: They climbed the high mountain together.
examples.cn: 他们一起爬上了那座高山。

mountain.etymology: 源自拉丁语 mons(山)的派生词。

definitions.en: an act of changing place or position; a step you take to do something
to change place or position

examples.en: That was a smart move in the game.
examples.cn: 那在游戏里是聪明的一步。

move.etymology: 源自拉丁语 movere，意为移动。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调一连串动作中的一步

definitions.en: pleasant sounds made by voices or instruments

examples.en: She listens to music while she works.

music.etymology: 源自希腊语 mousike，意为缪斯女神的技艺。

examples.en: What's your name?

definitions.en: a country and all the people who live in it

examples.en: The whole nation watched the game on TV.
examples.cn: 举国上下都在电视上观看这场比赛。

nation.etymology: 源自拉丁语 natio，意为出生、种族。

synonyms.nuance: 更侧重地域,nation 更侧重人民整体

definitions.en: a situation in which something is wanted or required
to want or require something

examples.en: There is a need for more food in the village.
examples.cn: 村子里需要更多的食物。

need.etymology: 源自古英语 nied，意为必要、迫切。

synonyms.nuance: want 偏愿望,need 偏必需

definitions.en: new information about recent events

examples.en: I heard the good news this morning.
examples.cn: 我今早听到了这个好消息。

news.etymology: 源自中古英语,意为新事物的复数,即新消息。

synonyms.nuance: 范围更广,不限于新近发生的事

definitions.en: the dark part of the day when the sun is down

examples.en: The stars are bright at night.

night.etymology: 源自古英语 niht，印欧语系共有的词。

definitions.en: a loud or unpleasant sound

examples.en: The loud noise woke the baby.
examples.cn: 巨大的噪音吵醒了宝宝。

noise.etymology: 源自古法语 noise，意为吵闹、争吵。

synonyms.nuance: 中性词,noise 多指不悦耳的声音

definitions.en: a short piece of writing to help you remember something
a single musical sound or the sign for it

examples.en: She left a note on the kitchen table.
examples.cn: 她在厨房桌子上留了张便条。

note.etymology: 源自拉丁语 nota，意为标记、记号。

synonyms.nuance: 更指要传达的内容本身

definitions.en: a word or sign that shows how many
a set of figures used to name or call something

examples.en: Please write your phone number here.
examples.cn: 请把你的电话号码写在这里。

number.etymology: 源自拉丁语 numerus，意为数目。

synonyms.nuance: 更指书写出来的数码符号

definitions.en: the act of watching something carefully

examples.en: His careful observation helped solve the problem.
examples.cn: 他仔细的观察帮助解决了问题。

observation.etymology: 源自拉丁语 observare(注视),由 ob-(朝向)加 servare(守视)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 更日常,observation 更正式、更系统

definitions.en: something that you say you are willing to give or do
to say you are willing to give or do something

examples.en: They made a good offer for the old car.
examples.cn: 他们为那辆旧车出了个好价钱。

offer.etymology: 源自拉丁语 offerre，意为呈上、献上。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,常用于计划或方案

definitions.en: a thick liquid from plants, animals, or the ground, used for cooking, fuel, etc.

examples.en: She put some oil in the hot pan.

oil.etymology: 源自拉丁语 oleum，意为橄榄油。

definitions.en: the way something works or is made to work
the cutting of a body by a doctor to fix or remove a part

examples.en: The doctor said the operation went well.

operation.etymology: 源自拉丁语 operari(工作),由 opus(工作)派生。

synonyms.nuance: 专指医疗手术,operation 更通用

definitions.en: what you think or believe about something

examples.en: In my opinion, the book is very good.
examples.cn: 在我看来,这本书非常好。

opinion.etymology: 源自拉丁语 opinio，意为信念、看法。

synonyms.nuance: 更中性,opinion 更强调个人判断

definitions.en: the way things are arranged, one after another
an instruction to do something, or a request for goods

examples.en: Please put the books in order.

order.etymology: 源自拉丁语 ordo，意为行列、次序。

synonyms.nuance: 语气更强,多用于军事或权威

definitions.en: a group of people who work together for a common aim
the act of arranging something in an orderly way

examples.en: She works for a large organization.

organization.etymology: 源自希腊语 organon(工具、器官)的派生词。

definitions.en: an object that you put somewhere to make it look nice

examples.en: A small ornament stood on the table.
examples.cn: 桌上摆着一件小装饰品。

ornament.etymology: 源自拉丁语 ornare(装饰)派生的 ornamentum。

definitions.en: a person who owns or has something

examples.en: The owner of the shop is very kind.
examples.cn: 这家店的店主非常和善。

owner.etymology: 由动词 own(拥有)加后缀 -er(行为者)构成。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调暂时持有,owner 强调所有权

definitions.en: one side of a sheet of paper in a book or magazine

examples.en: Please turn to the next page.

page.etymology: 源自拉丁语 pagina，意为(书写的)一页。

definitions.en: the bad feeling you have when part of your body hurts

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her arm.

pain.etymology: 源自拉丁语 poena，意为惩罚、痛苦。

synonyms.nuance: 多指持续的钝痛,pain 范围更广

definitions.en: a colored liquid that you put on a surface to color it
to put paint on something, or to make a picture with paint

examples.en: The walls need a fresh coat of paint.
examples.cn: 墙壁需要重新刷一层漆。

paint.etymology: 源自拉丁语 pingere，意为绘画、上色。

synonyms.nuance: 更泛指色彩,paint 指实际涂料

definitions.en: the thin flat material used for writing or printing on

examples.en: He wrote his name on a piece of paper.
examples.cn: 他把名字写在一张纸上。

paper.etymology: 源自希腊语 papyros，意为纸莎草。

definitions.en: one of the pieces or amounts that make up a whole

examples.en: This is the best part of the story.
examples.cn: 这是故事最精彩的部分。

part.etymology: 源自拉丁语 pars，意为部分。

definitions.en: a soft, wet mixture that is easy to spread or stick
to stick something to a surface with glue

examples.en: He used a little paste to fix the paper.
examples.cn: 他用一点糨糊把纸粘好。

paste.etymology: 源自晚期拉丁语 pasta，意为面团、糊。

definitions.en: money that is given to pay for something, or the act of paying

examples.en: We received your payment last week.
examples.cn: 我们上周收到了你的付款。

payment.etymology: 由动词 pay(支付)加后缀 -ment(行为或结果)构成。

definitions.en: a time when there is no war or fighting
a calm and quiet feeling or state

examples.en: Everyone hopes for peace in the world.

peace.etymology: 源自拉丁语 pax，意为和平。

synonyms.nuance: 更指内心或环境的安宁

definitions.en: a man, woman, or child

examples.en: She is a very kind person.

person.etymology: 源自拉丁语 persona，意为(戏剧中的)角色、面具。

definitions.en: a particular area or position
to put something in a particular position

examples.en: This is a good place to rest.

place.etymology: 源自拉丁语 platea，意为宽阔的街道、广场。

synonyms.nuance: 更口语,指较小的具体地点

definitions.en: a living thing that grows in the ground, like a tree or flower
a building where things are made using machines

examples.en: The plant needs water and sun to grow.
examples.cn: 这株植物需要水和阳光才能生长。

plant.etymology: 源自拉丁语 planta，意为幼苗、植物。

synonyms.nuance: 作工厂义时与 plant 近义,plant 常指大型生产厂

definitions.en: activities done for fun, especially by children
a story acted on a stage or for TV

examples.en: We saw a wonderful play at the theatre.
examples.cn: 我们在剧院看了一出精彩的戏。

play.etymology: 源自古英语 plega，意为玩耍、活动。

definitions.en: a happy or enjoyable feeling

examples.en: It is a pleasure to meet you.

pleasure.etymology: 源自古法语 plaisir，由拉丁语 placere(使愉快)派生。

definitions.en: a small dot or the sharp end of something
an important idea or the main thing being said

examples.en: That is a very good point.

point.etymology: 源自拉丁语 punctum，意为刺出的点。

synonyms.nuance: 更宽泛,point 多指论述中的要点

definitions.en: a substance that can harm or kill if it gets into the body

examples.en: Some plants make a strong poison.
examples.cn: 有些植物会产生强烈的毒素。

poison.etymology: 源自拉丁语 potio(饮剂),与 potion 同源。

synonyms.nuance: 更专业、更科学,多指生物毒素

definitions.en: a substance used to make a surface smooth and shiny
to rub something to make it smooth and shiny

examples.en: He gave his shoes a good polish.

polish.etymology: 源自拉丁语 polire，意为使光滑。

synonyms.nuance: 更指结果的明亮,polish 强调动作或用品

definitions.en: a person whose job is to carry bags or goods
a person who looks after the door of a large building

examples.en: The porter carried our bags to the room.
examples.cn: 行李员把我们的包搬到了房间。

porter.etymology: 源自拉丁语 portare(搬运)及 porta(门),含搬运与守门两源。

definitions.en: the place where someone or something is
a job, or the way you think about something

examples.en: Put the chair back in its right position.
examples.cn: 把椅子放回正确的位置。

position.etymology: 源自拉丁语 ponere(放置)的派生词 positio。

synonyms.nuance: 更日常,position 更强调确切的方位

definitions.en: very small dry pieces, like dust, made by crushing something

examples.en: She mixed the white powder with water.
examples.cn: 她把白色粉末和水混合在一起。

powder.etymology: 源自拉丁语 pulvis，意为尘土、粉末。

synonyms.nuance: 多指自然飘落的细尘,powder 多为人为研磨

definitions.en: the ability to do something or to act
control over people, or energy such as electricity

examples.en: The king had great power over the land.
examples.cn: 国王对这片土地拥有极大的权力。

power.etymology: 源自古法语 poeir，由拉丁语 posse(能够)派生。

synonyms.nuance: 更指身体的力量,power 含权力与能量义

definitions.en: the amount of money you must pay to buy something

examples.en: The price of the book is too high.

price.etymology: 源自拉丁语 pretium，意为价值、报酬。

synonyms.nuance: 更指花费的总额,price 指标出的售价

definitions.en: letters or marks made on paper by a machine; a mark left by pressing
to put words or pictures onto paper using a machine

examples.en: The book is now in print.
She left a clear print in the soft sand.
examples.cn: 她在松软的沙子上留下了清晰的印记。

print.etymology: 源自古法语 preindre“压、印”,最终来自拉丁语 premere“压”。

synonyms.nuance: 更泛指任何痕迹,不限于按压所留

definitions.cn: 一系列为达成结果而进行的动作或步骤
definitions.en: a series of actions or steps taken to reach a result

examples.en: Learning a language is a slow process.
examples.cn: 学习一门语言是一个缓慢的过程。

examples.en: We must follow each step of the process.
examples.cn: 我们必须遵循这一过程的每一步。

process.etymology: 源自拉丁语 processus“前进、进展”,来自 procedere“向前走”。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调既定的正式步骤

definitions.en: food grown on farms, such as fruit and vegetables
to make or grow something

examples.en: The market sells fresh produce every day.
examples.cn: 这个市场每天出售新鲜农产品。

examples.en: Local farms produce a lot of fruit.
examples.cn: 当地农场出产大量水果。

produce.etymology: 源自拉丁语 producere“引出、生出”,由 pro-“向前”加 ducere“引导”构成。

synonyms.nuance: 更指田间种植的作物本身

definitions.cn: 收入减去成本后剩下的钱
definitions.en: the money you gain after costs are taken away

examples.en: The shop made a good profit this year.
examples.cn: 这家店今年获得了不错的利润。

examples.en: They sold the house at a profit.

profit.etymology: 源自拉丁语 profectus“进展、收益”,来自 proficere“前进、有益”。

synonyms.nuance: 更泛指任何所得,不限金钱

definitions.cn: 归某人所有的东西;房地产
definitions.en: something that belongs to a person; land or buildings
a quality that something has

examples.en: This land is private property.
Water has the property of taking any shape.
examples.cn: 水具有任意成形的特性。

property.etymology: 源自拉丁语 proprietas“所有权、本性”,来自 proprius“自己的”。

definitions.cn: 普通的书面语言,区别于诗歌
definitions.en: ordinary written language, not poetry

examples.en: He writes simple, clear prose.
The story is told in prose, not in verse.
examples.cn: 这个故事以散文而非诗歌写成。

prose.etymology: 源自拉丁语 prosa (oratio)“直白的言语”,来自 prorsus“直接的”。

definitions.cn: 对某事表示强烈反对的言行
definitions.en: a strong statement or action against something
to say or show that you do not agree with something

examples.en: They held a protest in the square.
examples.cn: 他们在广场上举行了一场抗议。

examples.en: She left the room as a protest.

protest.etymology: 源自拉丁语 protestari“公开作证、声明”,由 pro-“公开地”加 testari“作证”构成。

synonyms.nuance: 语气较温和,多指口头不同意

definitions.cn: 朝自己方向用力的动作
definitions.en: an act of moving something toward you
to move something toward you using force

examples.en: Give the rope a hard pull.
Please pull the door to open it.

definitions.cn: 因做错事而受到的对待
definitions.en: something bad done to a person because of a wrong act

examples.en: The punishment for the crime was very hard.
examples.cn: 这项罪行的惩罚非常严厉。

examples.en: Going to bed early was his punishment.
examples.cn: 早早上床是对他的惩罚。

punishment.etymology: 源自动词 punish(来自拉丁语 punire“惩罚”)加名词后缀 -ment。

synonyms.nuance: 多用于正式规则或法律语境

definitions.cn: 做某事的原因或想达到的目标
definitions.en: the reason for doing something; what you want to achieve

examples.en: What is the purpose of this meeting?
examples.cn: 这次会议的目的是什么?

examples.en: He came here with one clear purpose.
examples.cn: 他带着一个明确的目的来到这里。

purpose.etymology: 源自古法语 porpos“意图”,来自拉丁语 proponere“提出”。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调具体想达到的结果

definitions.en: an act of pressing something to move it away
to press something to move it away from you

examples.en: Give the car a push.
Don't push so hard.

push.etymology: 源自古法语 pousser“推、压”,来自拉丁语 pulsare“敲、击”。

definitions.en: how good or bad something is
a feature that someone or something has

examples.en: This cloth is of high quality.
Kindness is a good quality.

quality.etymology: 源自拉丁语 qualitas“性质”,来自 qualis“怎样的”。

definitions.cn: 为得到回答而提出的话
definitions.en: a sentence you say or write to get an answer
to ask someone something; to doubt something

examples.en: May I ask you a question?
Her question made everyone think.
examples.cn: 她的问题让大家都陷入思考。

question.etymology: 源自拉丁语 quaestio“探询”,来自 quaerere“寻求、询问”。

synonyms.nuance: 更正式,常指需要澄清的小疑问

definitions.en: water that falls from clouds in drops
(of water) to fall from the sky

examples.en: The rain fell all night.
We stayed inside because of the rain.
examples.cn: 因为下雨我们待在室内。

rain.etymology: 源自古英语 regn“雨”,属日耳曼语族同源词。

definitions.cn: 上下限之间的全部区间
definitions.en: the limits between which something can change
a group of things of the same kind

examples.en: The shop sells a wide range of books.
examples.cn: 这家店出售种类繁多的书籍。

examples.en: The price is out of my range.
examples.cn: 这个价格超出了我的范围。

range.etymology: 源自古法语 range“行、列”,来自 rang“排列”。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调所及的程度或领域

definitions.cn: 某事发生或变化的速度或比例
definitions.en: how fast or how often something happens; a fixed amount

examples.en: He works at a fast rate.
The birth rate is going down.

rate.etymology: 源自拉丁语 rata (pars)“按比例分配的部分”,来自 reri“计算”。

synonyms.nuance: 仅指快慢,不含比例或价格之意

definitions.en: a narrow line of light or energy

examples.en: A ray of sun came through the window.
examples.cn: 一缕阳光透过窗户照进来。

examples.en: The first rays of morning lit the sky.
examples.cn: 清晨的第一缕光照亮了天空。

ray.etymology: 源自古法语 rai“光束”,来自拉丁语 radius“辐条、光线”。

definitions.en: something you feel or do because of something else

examples.en: What was her reaction to the news?
examples.cn: 她对这个消息有什么反应?

examples.en: His first reaction was to laugh.

reaction.etymology: 由前缀 re-“回”加 action“行动”构成,源自拉丁语 reagere。

synonyms.nuance: 更中性,可指有意的答复

definitions.en: the act of looking at and understanding written words
a number shown by a measuring instrument

examples.en: Reading is her favorite hobby.
examples.cn: 阅读是她最喜欢的爱好。

examples.en: Take a reading from the meter.
examples.cn: 从仪表上读取一个读数。

reading.etymology: 由动词 read(古英语 rædan“解读、建议”)加 -ing 构成。

definitions.cn: 某事发生的原因或解释
definitions.en: why something happens or is done
the power of the mind to think clearly

examples.en: Give me one good reason.
There is no reason to be afraid.

reason.etymology: 源自古法语 raison,来自拉丁语 ratio“计算、推理”。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调直接引发结果的事物

definitions.cn: 为日后查看而保存的信息
definitions.en: information kept so it can be looked at later
to write down or store information or sound

examples.en: Keep a record of your spending.
She holds the world record.

record.etymology: 源自拉丁语 recordari“记起、回忆”,由 re-“再”加 cor“心”构成。

definitions.cn: 对已发生之事感到难过或惋惜
definitions.en: a sad feeling about something that has happened
to feel sorry about something

examples.en: She felt deep regret for her words.
examples.cn: 她为自己的话深感后悔。

examples.en: I have no regret about leaving.

regret.etymology: 源自古法语 regreter“哀悼、惋惜”。

synonyms.nuance: 更宽泛的悲痛,不必针对自己的行为

definitions.en: the way two things are connected
a member of your family

examples.en: There is a close relation between the two.
examples.cn: 这两者之间有密切的关系。

examples.en: He is a relation of mine.

relation.etymology: 源自拉丁语 relatio“关系、带回”,来自 referre“带回、关联”。

definitions.cn: 对神或某种力量的信仰及相关活动
definitions.en: belief in a god or gods and the acts done because of it

examples.en: People of every religion live here.
examples.cn: 各种宗教信仰的人都住在这里。

examples.en: Religion is important to many people.
examples.cn: 宗教对许多人来说很重要。

religion.etymology: 源自拉丁语 religio“敬畏、虔诚”,或与 religare“捆绑”有关。

synonyms.nuance: 更强调个人内心的相信

definitions.cn: 代表他人行事或发言的人
definitions.en: a person chosen to act or speak for others
typical of a group

examples.en: She is our representative at the meeting.
examples.cn: 她是我们在会议上的代表。

examples.en: Each class sent one representative.
examples.cn: 每个班级派出一名代表。

representative.etymology: 由 represent(re-“再”加 present“呈现”)加后缀 -ative 构成。

synonyms.nuance: 更偏向受委托办事的人

definitions.cn: 客气地要某物或要某人做事
definitions.en: an act of politely asking for something
to ask for something politely

examples.en: I made a request for more time.
The song was played by request.
examples.cn: 这首歌是应要求播放的。

request.etymology: 源自古法语 requeste,来自拉丁语 requirere“寻求、需要”。

definitions.en: a feeling of valuing someone or something
to think highly of someone or something

examples.en: They show great respect for their teacher.
In this respect, he is right.

respect.etymology: 源自拉丁语 respectus“回看、顾及”,由 re-“回”加 specere“看”构成。

definitions.en: a time of not working in order to get back energy
the part that is left

examples.en: You need some rest.
I'll keep the rest for later.

rest.etymology: “休息”义源自古英语 ræst;“其余”义源自古法语 reste,来自拉丁语 restare“留下”。

definitions.cn: 因好行为或努力而得到的东西
definitions.en: something given for good work or behavior
to give something for good work or behavior

examples.en: He got a reward for his help.
Hard work brings its own reward.

reward.etymology: 源自古北法语 reward“看待、关注”,后引申为“回报”。

definitions.cn: 声音或动作有规律地重复
definitions.en: a regular pattern of sounds or movements

examples.en: I love the rhythm of this song.
They danced to the rhythm of the drum.
examples.cn: 他们随着鼓的节奏起舞。

rhythm.etymology: 源自希腊语 rhythmos“量度、流动”,来自 rhein“流动”。

definitions.cn: 一种白色的谷物,亚洲主要食物
definitions.en: a white grain used as food, common in Asia

examples.en: We eat rice every day.
Rice grows in wet fields.

rice.etymology: 源自古法语 ris,经希腊语 oryza,最终或来自古印度-伊朗语。

definitions.cn: 流向海或湖的大股流水
definitions.en: a large natural flow of water moving to the sea or a lake

examples.en: A long river runs through the city.
Children played by the river.

river.etymology: 源自古法语 riviere,来自拉丁语 riparia“河岸”。

definitions.cn: 供车辆和行人通行的硬质路面
definitions.en: a hard way made for cars and people to travel on

examples.en: The road goes up the hill.
Be careful when you cross the road.

road.etymology: 源自古英语 rad“骑行、旅程”,与 ride 同源。

synonyms.nuance: 多指城镇中两侧有建筑的路

definitions.cn: 卷成圆筒状的东西;名单
definitions.en: something turned round into a tube shape; a list of names
to move by turning over and over; to make into a tube

examples.en: She bought a roll of cloth.
The ball began to roll down the hill.

roll.etymology: 源自古法语 rolle,来自拉丁语 rotula“小轮”,rota“轮”的指小形式。

synonyms.nuance: 更泛指改变方向或翻转

definitions.cn: 建筑物中四壁围成的部分
definitions.en: a part of a building with walls around it
space that can be used

examples.en: There is a bed in the room.
Is there room for one more?
examples.cn: 还有空位再坐一个人吗?

room.etymology: 源自古英语 rum“空间、宽阔”。

synonyms.nuance: 更抽象,不一定指有墙的房间

definitions.en: an act of moving something back and forth against a surface
to move something back and forth against a surface

examples.en: Give your hands a quick rub.
She likes to rub the cat's head.

rub.etymology: 中古英语 rubben,具体来源不明,可能与低地德语相关。

definitions.cn: 规定该如何做事的准则
definitions.en: a statement of what you must or must not do
to govern; to make an official decision

examples.en: We must obey the rule.
